resources.string: HorizonCam needs camera access to work. Microphone is used for video sound.

Your video stays perfectly level, even if you rotate the phone a full 360°.

• The yellow frame is exactly what gets recorded. It stays level with the real horizon while you move.
• You can record landscape video while holding the phone upright. Pick the frame with the orientation button at the top.
• 360° Lock crops the most. Auto Level crops less and fixes tilts up to ±30°.
• Tap to focus. Long-press to lock focus and exposure. Pinch to zoom.
